from datetime import datetime

# Login
pw=[a for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='spotify'][0]['password']
login=apis.spotify.login(username='jes.mill@gmail.com', password=pw)
token=login['access_token']

# Collect all song_ids across libraries
song_ids=set()
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for s in page:
        song_ids.add(s['song_id'])
    page_index += 1

album_song_ids=set()
page_index=0
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for a in page:
        for sid in (a.get('song_ids') or []):
            album_song_ids.add(sid)
    page_index += 1

playlist_song_ids=set()
page_index=0
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for pl in page:
        for sid in (pl.get('song_ids') or []):
            playlist_song_ids.add(sid)
    page_index += 1

all_song_ids=song_ids | album_song_ids | playlist_song_ids

# Find newest released by release_date
max_dt=None
max_title=None
for sid in all_song_ids:
    info=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    rd=info.get('release_date')
    if not rd:
        continue
    dt=datetime.fromisoformat(rd)
    if (max_dt is None) or (dt>max_dt):
        max_dt=dt
        max_title=info.get('title')
        max_sid=sid

print('newest_title', max_title)
print('newest_release_date', max_dt.isoformat(), 'song_id', max_sid)

# Complete task
res=apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=max_title)
print('complete_task', res)
